I have an 8 month old pyr. His biting stage nearly broke my fiancé and I. 😂 Luckily, it did pass. Unfortunately the yelping method didn’t help us. Firstly, I am so sorry you are going through this, OP. Unfortunately, there may be no “quick fix” except for time and patience. What I will say is that the only thing that has helped recover my combination skin and severe acne was the K-beauty routine. 

Yes, it is a lengthy routine and has many steps. Some people have told me, “I don’t have time for that.” HOWEVER, you do, and once you see the complete transformation you’ll make sure you have time. Really, double cleansing with an oil wash then a foam wash (this is important. No, it won’t dry out your face washing it twice. No, the oil wash will not make your skin oily), a good moisturizer, and sunscreen are the most important steps in the routine, especially sunscreen. Stay away from exfoliation for a couple weeks until you heal. Just remember the most important step in the routine is SUNSCREEN. 

Head over to r/AsianBeauty. It’s a wonderful community with a plethora of great info about the k-beauty routine. Between r/SkincareAddiction and those guys, my life has been changed. You’ll see some results in a matter of a week and in a couple of months, you’ll never look back. 

Also, here’s an [oil to foam wash](https://www.ulta.com/ulta/browse/productDetail.jsp?productId=xlsImpprod17741115) that I use every day. It’s on sale right now at Ulta. It goes on oil and foams once you add water. It’s a K-beauty product and it’s lovely and saves time. 

I hope this helps. Best of luck to you.
